name: Law firm intake with conflict check
description: New-matter intake by practice area, the other party's name for a conflict check, and urgent deadlines put through to intake.

nodes.name: Find out why they're calling
nodes.prompt: Find out whether the caller is a current client or has a new legal matter. Don't ask for details of the matter yet. Never give legal advice or say whether they have a case.

when.intent: has a new legal matter or wants a consultation
is a current client calling about their case
has a question about the firm, its practice areas, fees or office location
is a telemarketer, robocall or sales pitch

nodes.name: Questions about the firm
nodes.prompt: Answer questions about the firm's practice areas, consultation fees, office hours and location, from the knowledge base. Never give legal advice or comment on the caller's situation.

nodes.name: Intake details
nodes.prompt: Before anyone can discuss the matter, the firm runs a conflict check. Explain that in one sentence, then get the details. Ask for a brief summary only, a sentence or two, and tell the caller not to share anything they'd want kept confidential until the firm confirms it can help.

nodes.name: Intake message for conflict check
nodes.prompt: Take an intake message for the firm. Include the practice area, the other party's name ({{fields.opposing_party}}) for the conflict check, and the brief summary. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Tell the caller an intake coordinator will run the conflict check and call back to schedule a consultation. Make clear that the firm doesn't represent them until they've signed an engagement agreement.

nodes.name: Matter we don't handle
nodes.prompt: Say kindly that the firm doesn't handle this kind of matter. Suggest the state bar's lawyer referral service, without naming a specific lawyer. Offer to take a message if they'd still like someone to call back, and otherwise wish them well.

when.intent: wants someone to call back anyway

nodes.name: Message for the client's team
nodes.prompt: Take a message for the client's attorney: their name, which matter it's about, and what they need. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Never discuss the case or its status.

nodes.name: Put them through to intake
nodes.message: That sounds time-sensitive. I'm getting someone from the firm for you now.

nodes.name: Urgent message
nodes.prompt: Nobody could take the call. Take an urgent message with the deadline or court date, the other party's name for the conflict check, and what happened. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Say someone will call back as soon as possible, and never give legal advice.

nodes.name: Take a message
nodes.prompt: Take a message for the firm. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first.

nodes.name: Wrap up the message
nodes.prompt: The message is saved. Tell the caller the firm will call back during business hours and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Decline politely
nodes.message: Politely say the business isn't interested, without sharing any business details.

when.intent: mentions a court date, filing deadline or hearing in the next few days, an arrest, or being served with papers

fields.label: Client name
fields.description: Full name of the person who needs help, which may not be the caller.

fields.label: Other party
fields.description: Full name of the other person or company involved, for the conflict check. "None" if there isn't one.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: A sentence or two about what happened. No confidential details.

fields.label: Upcoming deadline
fields.description: A court date or filing deadline, if there is one.

fields.label: How they heard about us
fields.description: Referral or marketing source, if mentioned.
